text:
alex_che: Quick idea — can we agree on a tiny acceptance checklist for "mini" model onboards (7B-ish, q4/ql8) so we can fast-accept candidates?
maya: yes please. our slow onboards are killing cadence.
sam_b: +1. want a checklist that covers perf + obvious quality regressions only, not full eval.
irene: what do you want in perf? p95 / tokens/sec / mem?
alex_che: minimal perf: median latency <= baseline *0.75 for same batch, and P95 <= baseline *0.9. tokens/sec uplift > 1.25. memory within 10%.
jordana: for quality: pass the smoke set (50 prompts) with <=1% top-1 regression on our correctness metric, and no >5% increase in hallucination flags.
maya: ok but add an explicit check for safety-related outputs (the toy safety prompts). zero new hits.
sam_b: also require a quick sampling-stability check: 200 seeds, KL to baseline < 0.02 for token distribution on the smoke set.
alex_che: good. also require a speculative-decoding compatibility check: enable speculative path and run 1k requests, ensure no runtime failures and end-to-end success rate >= 99.5%.
benchbot: running quick harness: model=model-mini-7b-ql8, quant=ql8, speculative=true
benchbot: result summary: median_lat=73ms (baseline 110ms), p95=210ms (baseline 260ms), tps=285 tok/s (baseline 210 tok/s), mem=12.4GB (baseline 11.6GB)
benchbot: smoke-set correctness: 98.0% (baseline 98.7%), hallucination_flags +3.2% relative, safety_hits=0 new
benchbot: sampling KL=0.015 over 200 seeds, speculative-run success=99.6%
maya: bench looks promising for perf. small correctness dip though, 0.7% absolute. do we accept?
irene: can we triage the correctness failures quickly — are they formatting vs factual?
jordana: I spot-checked 10 fails: 6 formatting (trailing newline/case), 4 factual (minor numeric differences). none safety-critical.
sam_b: would be fine to accept to fast-track but add a monitoring rollout with 10% traffic and a rollback trigger of >1% absolute correctness drop in production.
alex_che: agreed. action items: (1) maya will open a canary rollout config with rollback hooks, (2) sam will add the mini smoke-check to onboarding script, (3) irene will run a 10k-sample sanity run overnight to confirm 
maya: copying the canary config from last time — will post link in a sec.
maya: config: 
```yaml
canary: 10%
monitoring: [correctness, hallucination_flags, latency_p95]
rollback: correctness_absolute_drop > 1.0% OR hallucination_flags_relative_increase > 5%
```
sam_b: I'll make the onboarding harness require benchbot pass + the smoke checks before marking as "fast-accepted".
irene: for the overnight run, I'll check KL drift over time slices (first/last 2k requests) — want to catch temporal staleness.
jordana: do we record the sample-level diffs so we can triage without rerunning?
benchbot: yes: full diff artifact uploaded to s3://redwood-test-artifacts/mini-7b-ql8/1748201357/diffs.tar.gz
alex_che: perfect. if overnight run shows no additional regressions, target to flip canary to 100% in 24 hours.
maya: ack. thanks team. :rocket:
sam_b: small note: we should run this same checklist for any quant variants (ql4/ql8) but adjust memory thresholds.
alex_che: noted. will add variant-specific thresholds to the checklist doc.
jordana: filing a short post-accept checklist so ops knows rollback steps.
maya: closing loop — will post final acceptance decision tomorrow AM after irene's run. :thumbsup:
